_doc: Override map for tests/compat/auto-answer-hook.cjs. Keys are question.header (12-char chip). Values are the chosen option.label (must match an actual options[].label in the question). Multi-select questions use comma-separated labels: 'LabelA,LabelB'. Default behavior (no override) is options[0].label per CLAUDE.md regra mestra. Add an entry here ONLY when the first option is NOT the desired answer for a specific gate during real-mode compat regression. Examples below are commented out (JSON has no comments — they live in this _doc string instead). EXAMPLE 1: ADVERSARIAL_GATE in ux-fixture should SKIP (label 'Skip') because the UX simulation domain accepts opt-out — set 'Adversarial': 'Skip'. EXAMPLE 2: closeout for hotfix should pick 'Keep uncommitted' instead of default 'Commit + Push + PR' — set 'Closeout': 'Keep uncommitted'. As of v4.16.0 initial capture, no overrides are needed for bugfix-fixture (the smoke scenario in CI). Other fixtures may need overrides when they get real-mode baselines in v4.17.x+.
